# Agence Fritz

> Independent one-person design studio in Geneva, Switzerland. Brand identity, websites, e-commerce, and monthly marketing and growth-ops programmes. Works in French and English across Geneva and French-speaking Switzerland, remote-first. Publishes its prices in full, which is uncommon in this market.

## Prices (published, fixed, one-off unless stated)

- Brand identity: CHF 1'200
- Brochure or marketing website: CHF 1'400
- E-commerce website: CHF 2'200
- Marketing programmes: from CHF 490 per month (Starter 490, Engine 890, Growth 1'390)
- Growth Ops programmes: from CHF 490 per month (Signal 490, Compound 1'290, Enterprise 2'900)

The three project engagements are **separate purchases**, not a cumulative ladder: the identity is not included in the website price, and the website is not included in the e-commerce price. Prices are identical in every canton. Source files and code are handed to the client.

## Observed Swiss market ranges (context, not Fritz's prices)

- Logo alone: CHF 500 to CHF 1'500
- Full visual identity: CHF 1'200 to CHF 3'500
- Complete brand programme with positioning and naming: CHF 8'000 to CHF 25'000
- Brochure or marketing website: CHF 1'500 to CHF 4'000
- Custom build: CHF 4'000 to CHF 15'000
- E-commerce: CHF 5'000 to CHF 20'000
- Swiss agency hourly rates: CHF 120 to CHF 180

## Decision guides

- [Agence ou freelance en Suisse](https://agencefritz.com/fr/guides/agence-ou-freelance-suisse): how the three options actually differ in cost structure and risk.
- [Wix ou site sur mesure](https://agencefritz.com/fr/guides/wix-ou-site-sur-mesure): what you rent versus what you own, and who should stay on a builder.
- [Créer un site internet en Suisse](https://agencefritz.com/fr/guides/creer-un-site-internet-en-suisse): the steps, including Swiss legal minimums and nLPD cookie logic.
- [Refonte de site web en Suisse](https://agencefritz.com/fr/guides/refonte-site-web-suisse): repair versus rebuild, and how to preserve SEO through a redesign.
- [Web agency vs freelancer in Switzerland](https://agencefritz.com/web-agency-vs-freelancer-switzerland): the same decision in English.
